about: Decisions for the Design page of the official Arts (/collection/arts/design). The order of items is the order on the page: the Aspirants first, then their families and weapons by pair order, then the world. Every item is a picture the owner put in a design folder of media/_all (24 different pictures: 22 kept, 2 dropped below). Nothing from other folders was added. The script design.py reads this file and stops if a design picture is neither listed here nor dropped. Change a title or an alt here and run it again. A picture that changes content needs a new key: bump rev.
